notes.title: Ithaqua Labs has a new, free visual novel!
notes.content:
Hey everybody, we here at Ithaqua Labs have a new, free visual novel that you can play here on Steam.

[h1]Perceptions of the Dead[/h1]
[i]A light horror/comedy story.[/i]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/745760/Perceptions_of_the_Dead/]You can play it for free here![/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/745760/Perceptions_of_the_Dead/

[b]The first thing you need to know is that ghosts are real.
The rest, you can only learn on your own.[/b]

Follow three stories set in a world where the dead linger, and things far worse wait beyond the veil.

It has a few voices from the Book of Gray Magic that you guys might recognize!

Since it was met with great approval here on Steam, we've launched a Kickstarter for Part 2 to fund the voice acting for the game.

[h1]Perceptions of the Dead 2 - Kickstarter[/h1]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ithaqualabs/perceptions-of-the-dead-2

We hope you're all having a great new year.
-Ithaqua Labs

notes.title: Brilliant Shadows - 1.3 patch update
notes.content:
Greetings!
The last patch I did was one year ago tomorrow. Funny, huh?

Updates:
-Music normalized
-Preferences updated
-Textbox and font adjusted for easier reading
-Sprites alignment tweaked, fixed
-Updated a few sprites with new/fixed bug graphics
-Changed the voice actor for two characters, credits adjusted
-A few lines tweaked
-Transitions smoothed, added
